professionalSummary: Three years of experience as an Energy Analytics Analyst in a building services company, analysing metered energy data for 24 commercial buildings and identifying savings measures with expected savings.
experienceHighlights: Analyzed metered energy data under the team’s analysis procedure and identified savings measures with expected savings.
Prepared monthly performance reports for each landlord under energy performance contracts, accepted by landlords’ facilities managers.
Monitored contracted savings against the baseline each month, raising shortfalls to the account director and recording them in the savings register.
Coordinated measure proposals with site engineers via the measure log, documenting ownership and approvals held by the account director.
Authored limitation sections and hand‑over conditions for each measure proposal.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: one monthly performance report, two measure proposals with approval records, and a savings register extract for one quarter, including energy data platform references as a verification trail.
skills: Documentation of limitations and hand‑over conditions
